nodes.title: Ground the goal in the role graph
nodes.purpose: Which measures, sites, materials and documents the goal names.
nodes.how: Resolve every term in the goal to a governed measure, a site, a material or a document; list anything that does not resolve.
nodes.check: Every term maps to something the graph holds, or is listed as unresolved.

nodes.title: State the current position
nodes.purpose: Stock, orders and spend for everything in scope.
nodes.how: From the latest stock snapshot, the open order lines and the spend to date.
nodes.check: Totals reconcile to the governed measures within rounding.

nodes.title: Read what the documents and the mailbox say that the tables do not
nodes.purpose: Dated statements that differ from SAP or the contracts platform.
nodes.how: Supplier, plant and internal statements with dates or quantities.
nodes.check: Nothing is attributed without a dated reference.

nodes.title: Set out the ways forward and test them against the constraints
nodes.purpose: At least two courses of action with their trade-offs.
nodes.how: Against the policy, the inventory standard and the open goals on this role.
nodes.check: Each course states what it costs and what it protects.
